description:
Read the files of a number verification form, before the form is filled or submitted.

        This applies to a number offer, using the same quote and applicant type
        as the requirements. Known ``fields`` and ``address`` values can be partial.
        An AI model reads each file.
        Returns ``fields``, ``address`` and ``documents.<slot>.fields``: the values the
        files show, by the form's own keys, to fill the form after the user confirms
        them. ``documents.<slot>.option`` is the document type the file looks like.
        ``warnings`` (``field``, ``kind``, ``message``) lists what the carrier may
        refuse: an unreadable, upside-down or expired document, a file of another
        type than the chosen one, or a typed name that differs from the printed one.
        Each message names the fix. A submission with warnings is still accepted.
        A file nothing was read from has ``read`` false; an unclear file also has an
        ``unreadable`` warning, and a file past the daily reads has ``skipped``
        ``daily_limit``. Only the first 3 pages of a PDF are read; a PDF of more
        than 5 pages is not read.
        Each file read uses one of the workspace's daily document reads (30 per day);
        a file given for several slots uses one. Nothing is filed, saved, held or
        charged, and uploads stay usable.

city.description: City or town as it appears in the applicant's mailing address.
city.title: City

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code of the street address, such as `94103`.
postal_code.title: Postal Code

region.description: State, province, or equivalent administrative area in the applicant's address.
region.title: Region

address.description: Known parts of the applicant's address when the form requires one. The document check can suggest missing values and flag a mismatch in the name on the address.
address.title: Address

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as ``US``.
country_code.title: Country Code

documents.description: Map from each document slot to ``{option, fields, covers}``. ``option`` may be empty while the type is not chosen. ``covers`` lists the other slots the same file stands for: the file is sent once, for this slot, and one read fills all of them.
documents.title: Documents

fields.description: Applicant answers as text, keyed by the field names in ``get_verification_requirements``. Choice fields take comma-separated option keys.
fields.title: Fields

files.description: One file per slot being filled, keyed by the matching slot in ``documents``. Upload IDs come from ``create_file_upload`` with purpose ``verification_document`` and last one hour. The inline form suits small files. Each file is at most 10 MiB.

slot.description: The key in ``documents`` that identifies what this file proves.

content_base64.description: Bytes of the complete document for this slot, supplied directly in the tool call.

content_type.description: Media type of the actual document. Hail checks it against the file bytes.

slot.description: The key in ``documents`` that identifies what this file proves.

files.title: Files

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

number_type.description: The kind of number this registration covers. Copy it from the offer in ``quote_numbers`` or the number in ``list_numbers``.
number_type.title: Number Type

quote_id.description: Required for reading documents. This is the ``quote_id`` from ``quote_numbers`` for the offer used to get the form requirements.
quote_id.title: Quote Id

subject_type.description: Who the registration is for, matching the requirements: the user (``person``) or their company (``business``). It has no default; without it, nothing is sent.
subject_type.title: Subject Type

name: check_verification_documents

VerificationDocumentRead.description: What was read from one slot's file.

expiry_date.description: The expiry date printed on the file (YYYY-MM-DD), or null.
expiry_date.title: Expiry Date

fields.description: Values for the fields of the slot's document types, by field name, as printed on the file.
fields.title: Fields

file_slot.description: The slot whose file this was read from: this slot, or the slot whose file covers it. Slots with the same `file_slot` share one file. Null when not read.
file_slot.title: File Slot

none_of_types.description: True when the file was read and looks like none of the slot's document types (`option` is then null).
none_of_types.title: None Of Types

option.description: The slot's document type the file looks like, as an option key, or null when none fits or it was not read.
option.title: Option

printed_name.description: The name printed on the file, or null when not read.

read.description: False when nothing was read from the file: the reader is off, the file type is not supported, the read failed or took too long (no warning), or the file is unreadable (an 'unreadable' warning). The other values are then empty.
read.title: Read

skipped.description: Why the file was not read, when Hail chose not to: 'daily_limit' when the workspace has used today's document reads. Null otherwise.
skipped.title: Skipped

VerificationDocumentRead.title: VerificationDocumentRead

VerificationDocumentWarning.description:
Something on an uploaded document the carrier may refuse. A warning
only: you can still submit.

field.description: Where to show it: a slot name for the document itself, or the path of a typed value (`first_name`, `<slot>.<field>`, `address.customer_name`).
field.title: Field

kind.description: 'unreadable', 'rotated' (upside down or on its side), 'expired', 'document_type' (the file does not match the chosen type), or 'name' (the typed name differs from the printed one).
kind.title: Kind

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it.
message.title: Message

VerificationDocumentWarning.title: VerificationDocumentWarning

VerificationPrintedName.description: The name printed on a document, as read. Empty strings when not printed.

business_name.description: The name of the company the document is about or addressed to, never the company that issued it.
business_name.title: Business Name

given_names.description: The given names of the person the document is about or addressed to, never a person who signs for the issuer.
given_names.title: Given Names

latin_given_names.description: The given names in Latin letters as the document prints them (its machine-readable zone or a transliteration), or empty.
latin_given_names.title: Latin Given Names

latin_surnames.description: The surnames in Latin letters, the same way.
latin_surnames.title: Latin Surnames

VerificationPrintedName.title: VerificationPrintedName

address.description: Address parts read from the files (`customer_name`, `street`, `city`, `region`, `postal_code`, `country_code`). Only the parts found.
address.title: Address

documents.description: What was read from each slot that had a file, by slot name.
documents.title: Documents

fields.description: Values for the form's own `fields`, by field name, read from the files.
fields.title: Fields

note.description: What the check does not cover.
note.title: Note

warnings.description: Things the carrier may refuse. Empty when nothing was found.
warnings.title: Warnings

problems.description: Validation issues with an input path and a message.

title: Read verification documents
